name: Izakaya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood izakaya (Japanese pub): a business-hours notice, a first day working part-time, a menu guide, an online-reservation notice, a first-time-customer usage guide, a lesson in calling out to customers, teaching a junior how to pour beer, the shop's history of introducing tablet ordering, a banquet-plan guide, a cashless-payment trend column, a hybrid membership-rank system guide, a reflection on balancing efficiency and connection, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
